studio3d.history.title: History
studio3d.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
studio3d.keys.gizmo: Move, rotate or scale the selection
studio3d.keys.viewSave: Save the camera into a view slot
cmd.studio3d.view.keys: Show or hide the 3D keyboard shortcut help
studio3d.hist.moveRoot_other: Move {count} objects to the scene root
cmd.studio3d.mesh.simplify: Simplify a 3D mesh: remove vertices while keeping its shape, UVs and normals
cmd.studio3d.mesh.symmetrize: Bake a symmetry into 3D meshes: keep one side of the local mirror plane, mirror it onto the other and weld the seam
cmd.studio3d.mesh.subdivide: Subdivide 3D meshes smoothly: split every triangle into four and smooth the surface (Loop scheme)
cmd.studio3d.mesh.cleanup: Clean up 3D meshes: weld duplicate vertices, drop collapsed and duplicate faces and unify winding (closed parts point outward)
cmd.studio3d.mesh.normals: Rebuild the normals of 3D meshes: flip them, recalculate outward, or re-shade smooth, flat or split by angle
cmd.studio3d.mesh.separate: Split 3D meshes into one object per connected part
cmd.studio3d.mesh.solidify: Give a thin 3D mesh real thickness: offset shell with stitched side walls
cmd.studio3d.mesh.fillHoles: Cap the open borders of 3D meshes
cmd.studio3d.mesh.relax: Smooth a 3D mesh: vertices drift toward their neighbourhood average, borders stay put
cmd.studio3d.mesh.fatten: Shrink or fatten a 3D mesh along its normals (negative amounts shrink)
cmd.studio3d.mesh.bisect: Cut a 3D mesh with a plane and keep both halves
cmd.studio3d.mesh.twist: Twist a 3D mesh around an axis
cmd.studio3d.mesh.taper: Taper a 3D mesh along an axis
studio3d.mesh.taperFactor: Taper factor at the far end
cmd.studio3d.mesh.spin: Revolve a 3D mesh around an axis (lathe)
cmd.studio3d.mesh.bridge: Bridge two 3D meshes with a tunnel between their open borders
cmd.studio3d.texture.generate: Generate a procedural texture (checker, grid, stripes or noise) for a texture slot of the selected 3D object
cmd.studio3d.mesh.boolean: Combine two 3D meshes with a boolean: union, subtract or intersect
cmd.studio3d.mesh.remesh: Rebuild meshes as an even voxel grid (remesh): uniform watertight triangles, sharp features projected back
cmd.studio3d.edit.subdivide: Split selected triangles into four by edge midpoints
cmd.studio3d.edit.poke: Split selected triangles into three at their centroid
cmd.studio3d.edit.duplicate: Duplicate selected faces as a detached shell
cmd.studio3d.edit.fatten: Move selected vertices along their normals
cmd.studio3d.edit.relax: Smooth selected vertices towards their neighbours
cmd.studio3d.edit.flip: Flip the normals of selected faces
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectLinked: Select everything linked to the selection
cmd.studio3d.edit.dissolve: Merge selected faces into one face
cmd.studio3d.edit.fill: Fill the selected closed edge loop with a centroid triangle fan
cmd.studio3d.edit.collapse: Collapse each connected island of the selection into one vertex
cmd.studio3d.edit.toSphere: Pull the selected vertices onto a sphere
cmd.studio3d.edit.randomize: Jitter the selected vertices by a seeded random displacement
cmd.studio3d.edit.move: Move the selected vertices by an offset
cmd.studio3d.edit.rip: Rip the selected faces off the rest of the mesh
cmd.studio3d.edit.separate: Split the selected faces out into a new object
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectSharp: Select edges whose faces meet at an angle of at least the given degrees
cmd.studio3d.edit.rotate: Rotate the selected vertices around their centroid on a world axis
cmd.studio3d.edit.scale: Scale the selected vertices toward or away from their centroid
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectSimilar: Select faces whose normal is within the given angle of the current selection
cmd.studio3d.edit.shear: Shear the selected vertices along one axis by their position on another
cmd.studio3d.edit.flipEdge: Rotate each selected edge shared by two triangles to the other diagonal
cmd.studio3d.edit.mergeByDistance: Weld the selected vertices that lie within the given distance
cmd.studio3d.edit.bisect: Cut the edited mesh by an axis plane and keep both halves
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectLoop: Extend the selected edges to their full edge loops
cmd.studio3d.edit.bridgeFaces: Bridge the borders of two selected face groups of the edited 3D mesh with a sewn triangle strip
cmd.studio3d.edit.vertSlide: Slide the selected vertex of the edited 3D mesh along an incident edge by a factor of the edge vector
cmd.studio3d.edit.convexHull: Replace the edited 3D mesh with the convex hull of its selected vertices
cmd.studio3d.edit.symmetrize: Bake a mirror symmetry into the edited 3D mesh: keep one side of the local mirror plane, mirror it onto the other and weld the seam
cmd.studio3d.edit.shrinkwrap: Project the selected vertices of the edited 3D mesh onto the closest surface of another mesh
cmd.studio3d.edit.knife: Slice the selected faces of the edited 3D mesh with a free plane and keep both sides connected
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectPath: Select the shortest edge path between two vertices of the edited 3D mesh
cmd.studio3d.mesh.bend: Bend a 3D mesh sideways around the axis perpendicular to the deform axis
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectChecker: Deselect every nth selected element of the edited 3D mesh, starting at the offset
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectRandom: Select a seeded random share of the edited 3D mesh elements
cmd.studio3d.object.snapToGround: Drop 3D objects until their bounds rest on the ground plane
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectMirror: Mirror the selection of the edited 3D mesh across an axis plane
cmd.studio3d.mesh.screw: Revolve a 3D mesh around an axis while rising along it (helix)
cmd.studio3d.edit.selectFacing: Select faces of the edited 3D mesh pointing along a mesh axis direction
cmd.studio3d.cursor.toSelection: Move the 3D cursor to the selection centre
